name: app-onboarding-heading-slide-blue-eyebrow-and-large-black-statement
title: Onboarding Divider with Blue Eyebrow
whatItIs: A nearly empty white slide with a small blue uppercase eyebrow 'ONBOARDING', a large black two-line statement 'Personalization begins with a conversation.' and a one-line description.
whatItMeans: Only type and space make a calm section opener, and the blue label marks the section quietly.
techniques: Small blue eyebrow above a large statement
Left-aligned block placed low on the page

vocabulary.definition: A small label above a heading naming the section.
A slide that introduces a new part of a document.
A slide made only of text.
